items.title: Rival GMs make inbound trade offers the player must answer
items.premise: Trades are 100% player-initiated: grep for proposeTrade/inboundTrade/cpuTradeProposal across src/ and public/ returns zero hits; TradeService exposes only evaluate() and commit(); rival GM archetypes are a read-only scouting table that never acts on the player; the 9 Trade Deadline Frenzy action cards resolve to bare tab clicks.

L1.recipe: Deadline-week-only: generate one need-driven inbound offer per deadline window from a rival team, deliver as a Priority Inbox CRITICAL item with accept/decline through TradeService.evaluate/commit, deterministic RNG, focused test.

L2.recipe: Weekly archetype-driven inbound-offer engine: rival GMs with roster needs and archetype-shaped valuation (rebuild/contender/balanced trait deltas) generate bounded inbound offers (deterministic RNG, frequency spiking near the deadline), delivered as Priority Inbox items and a Trades-tab offer card with accept / decline / counter (counter re-prices via TradeService.evaluate and binds the state fingerprint so a stale league 409s before commit). Offers expire with receipts. Both adapters serve the same offer routes through a shared handler. Focused engine + service + browser tests; existing 560-test suite stays green.

L3.recipe: L2 plus per-counterparty relationship memory: repeated lowballs and reneged counters sour a rival GM's willingness receipts, cooling future offers, with the relationship visible in the scouting archetype table.
